memory_update.text: NNI should be tracked as an underfollowed education compliance/data infrastructure candidate because its campus payments and school information system assets are buried inside a broader student finance/loan-servicing company profile.
COUR is not just a learning marketplace; identity verification, credential integrity, learner analytics, and university data processing may form a compliance/data layer worth separate tracking.
MITK is a speculative shadow candidate for education identity verification. Keep in Layer 1 only until direct education customer or partner evidence is found.
Pearson/PSO should be used as a reference benchmark for testing and certification gate economics, not as the main alpha target for this underfollowed pass.

Key education compliance/data/identity assets are private or recently taken private: Instructure, PowerSchool, Meazure Learning/ProctorU, Persona, Prometric, ETS, Turnitin, and several proctoring/SIS vendors. Public-market discovery likely requires second-order suppliers or conglomerate segments.
